issue.title: fix(tools): edit_file leaves stale version tracking and makes the next write_file fail

steps:
In the current working directory, create a file named inventory.txt containing exactly these four lines:
apples=3
bananas=5
cherries=7
dates=9
Then confirm it was created.
In inventory.txt, change only the bananas line so that it reads bananas=6. Make a targeted edit of that one line; do not rewrite the whole file.

Now replace the entire contents of inventory.txt with exactly these two lines:
kiwis=1
lemons=2
You already have the complete new content from me, so do not read the file again first: make one write_file call with overwrite_read_confirm set to true (I confirm the blind replace). Then tell me whether that write succeeded on the first attempt, and if it was refused, quote the exact reason you were given.
expected: A session must not reject its own successful edit as an external modification.
defect: edit_file leaves stale version tracking and makes the next write_file fail.

fault location.explanation: The successful atomic write is followed by path-only tracking rather than a file-version refresh.

Root cause: Source at the recorded revision writes new content and performs path-only session tracking without refreshing the file-version record in this success path. Archived traces show a subsequent write refused as another agent changing the file. The fixed series has ten attempts: nine executed, one infrastructure failure, seven reported hits; two valid misses re-read the file and refreshed the record. Infrastructure failure is preserved but is not a hit. No fresh runtime reproduction was performed during this organization. Exact first fixing commit has not been established. Root steps describe the selected original case; other run-local cases can differ. Retained observations are not automatically independent same-prompt trials.

_meta.notes: Reused the existing ABB source-confirmed case. Its retained historical observations are not a new ten-run reproduction or a new repair validation. Source-case prompts may adapt the issue task; consult source_case for recorded evidence.
